Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works shall be 5 years.
2) The minimum specific experience in construction works of at least 1(One) contract(s) of Public ( Government, Semi
Government & Autonomous organisation) 4 (Four) Storied Building Construction successfully completed within the last 3 (Three)
years in each with a value of at least Tk. 1(One) Core Taka.
3) The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 02 (Two) Core over the last 05 (Five) years.
4) The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e. working capital or credit line(s) of the Tenderer shall be Tk 50 (Fifty) Lac.Specific
format of credit line uploaded section 7 in tender Document.
5) Tender Documents containing insufficient/incomplete information will be rejected.
6) Furnishing of any false, fake & forged document or information by a Tenderer shall result in rejection of his Tender and may lead
to forfeiture of Tender Security and action against Tenderer under Regulation of PPA 2008.
7) If Quoted rate is found more than 10% above or below Estimated cost, tender will be non-responsive.
